entries.title: 报价未回复的四封跟进邮件
entries.summary: 为无回复的报价写第 2、7、14、21 天四封简短友好的跟进邮件，不用强推销语气。
entries.prompt:
Write four short follow-up emails for a quote that got no reply. Under 120 words each. Plain, friendly tone. No pushy sales language.

Quote details: Customer: [NAME] Sent on: [DATE] Amount: [AMOUNT] What it covered: [SCOPE] Something useful to add: [PHOTO / TIMELINE / WARRANTY NOTE]

Email 1 (day 2): Confirm they received the quote, and ask if anything needs clarification. Email 2 (day 7): Re-enter with the useful thing above. Give them a real reason to reply.

Email 3 (day 14): Last check. Offer to check back later if the timing is wrong. Email 4 (day 21): Short close. I'm closing the quote on my end, reach out anytime.
entries.author: justinfredette
